messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick thread re: Carlos' partner's adoption leave starting 2026-09-15. Questions: is the adoption stipend taxable? reimbursement timing? Can we approve a 12-week adoption leave per policy? Also hiring needs a 3-month backfill contractor 12cc @hiring @payroll @benefits
Carlos - Hiring: Need to know if stipend can be advanced to help with placement fees. Hiring: can we fast-track contractor sourcing and background check? Also who handles laptop shipping for the contractor / pickup from the transitioning employee?
Payroll Bot: Automated note: adoption stipend is taxable income. Reimbursements processed within 2 pay cycles after receipts are submitted. Payroll advances possible with manager + finance approval; submit to payroll@redwood.com with employee ID.
Benefits Bot: Health/dental remain active for approved leave while employee stays enrolled. If leave is unpaid, premiums must be covered via payroll deduction or direct payment. Adoption assistance is separate from benefits.
Anna (Legal): For international adoption placements, we need placement documentation and may have country-specific reporting. Performance cycle note: reviews that fall during protected leave are treated neutrally; manager feedback can still be provided.
Maya (People Ops): We can approve 12 weeks under the family leave policy. For gross-up of stipend, we need finance approval 12I will schedule a 15-min sign-off call. For the contractor, hiring-ops must send a role spec and requested start date. For equipment: @eng-ops handles pickup/shipping (usually 7 business days).
Carlos - Hiring: I've posted the role spec to hiring-ops and requested expedited background. Will Carlos' manager confirm start date? Also confirming we may need a laptop pre-configured for the contractor.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Carlos: confirm if you want an advance and attach expected receipts timeline. 2) Carlos: share contractor spec & start date to hiring-ops. 3) Payroll: await advance request for gross-up review. 4) Benefits: confirm premium payment process if any unpaid period occurs. 5) Eng-ops: coordinate laptop ship/pickup.
Payroll Bot: Noted. Please email payroll@redwood.com with employee ID for any advance or gross-up requests.
HR Bot: Leave request created 12 ID LR-2026-9990. Maya (People Ops) assigned as case owner.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 12 I'll follow up with calendar invite for the stipend/finance sign-off and update this thread after the call.
